mod model;

pub use model::*;
mod source_store;

mod pcap;

pub use pcap::*;

pub use source_store::{import_source, SourceImportError};
#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use std::path::PathBuf;

    #[test]
    fn creates_a_complete_investigation() {
        let mut investigation = Investigation::new(
            InvestigationId(1),
            "Investigación de prueba",
            Some("Prueba del modelo de datos".to_string()),
            1_798_000_000_000_000_000,
        )
        .unwrap();

        investigation
            .add_source(SourceFile {
                id: SourceId(1),
                file_name: "capture.pcap".to_string(),
                relative_path: PathBuf::from("sources/capture.pcap"),
                format: SourceFormat::Pcap,
                size_bytes: 1024,
                sha256: None,
                imported_at_unix_ns: 1_798_000_000_000_000_000,
            })
            .unwrap();

        investigation
            .add_asset(Asset {
                id: AssetId(1),
                kind: AssetKind::IpAddress,
                value: "192.168.1.10".to_string(),
                label: Some("Equipo de prueba".to_string()),
            })
            .unwrap();

        investigation
            .add_evidence(Evidence {
                id: EvidenceId(1),
                source_id: SourceId(1),
                location: EvidenceLocation::PacketFrame {
                    frame_number: 1,
                },
                excerpt: Some("Primer paquete de la captura".to_string()),
            })
            .unwrap();

        investigation
            .add_event(NetworkEvent {
                id: EventId(1),
                timestamp_unix_ns: None,
                kind: EventKind::NetworkFlow,
                summary: "Conexión TCP observada".to_string(),
                source_asset: Some(AssetId(1)),
                destination_asset: None,
                source_port: Some(51000),
                destination_port: Some(443),
                protocol: Some(Protocol::Tcp),
                evidence_ids: vec![EvidenceId(1)],
            })
            .unwrap();

        investigation
            .add_finding(Finding {
                id: FindingId(1),
                kind: FindingKind::Observation,
                severity: Severity::Info,
                title: "Conexión identificada".to_string(),
                description: "Se observó una conexión TCP en la captura".to_string(),
                evidence_ids: vec![EvidenceId(1)],
                confidence_percent: Some(100),
            })
            .unwrap();

        assert_eq!(investigation.sources().len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(investigation.assets().len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(investigation.evidences().len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(investigation.events().len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(investigation.findings().len(), 1);
    }

    #[test]
    fn rejects_evidence_without_a_valid_source() {
        let mut investigation = Investigation::new(
            InvestigationId(1),
            "Prueba",
            None,
            0,
        )
        .unwrap();

        let evidence = Evidence {
            id: EvidenceId(1),
            source_id: SourceId(99),
            location: EvidenceLocation::LogLine {
                line_number: 10,
            },
            excerpt: None,
        };

        let result = investigation.add_evidence(evidence);

        assert_eq!(
            result,
            Err(DomainError::UnknownSource(SourceId(99)))
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn rejects_an_event_without_evidence() {
        let mut investigation = Investigation::new(
            InvestigationId(1),
            "Prueba",
            None,
            0,
        )
        .unwrap();

        let event = NetworkEvent {
            id: EventId(1),
            timestamp_unix_ns: None,
            kind: EventKind::Packet,
            summary: "Evento sin procedencia".to_string(),
            source_asset: None,
            destination_asset: None,
            source_port: None,
            destination_port: None,
            protocol: None,
            evidence_ids: Vec::new(),
        };

        let result = investigation.add_event(event);

        assert_eq!(
            result,
            Err(DomainError::MissingEvidence("El evento"))
        );
    }
}

ARCHIVO: ./src/model.rs

use std::fmt;
use std::path::PathBuf;

// Identificadores tipados: evitan confundir el ID de un evento
// con el ID de una fuente o una evidencia.
macro_rules! define_id {
    ($name:ident) => {
        #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, PartialOrd, Ord)]
        pub struct $name(pub u64);
    };
}

define_id!(InvestigationId);
define_id!(SourceId);
define_id!(AssetId);
define_id!(EvidenceId);
define_id!(EventId);
define_id!(FindingId);

// Errores que puede producir el modelo de datos.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum DomainError {
    EmptyField(&'static str),
    AbsoluteSourcePath,
    InvalidSha256,
    DuplicateId {
        entity: &'static str,
        id: u64,
    },
    UnknownSource(SourceId),
    UnknownAsset(AssetId),
    UnknownEvidence(EvidenceId),
    MissingEvidence(&'static str),
    InvalidConfidence(u8),
}

impl fmt::Display for DomainError {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        match self {
            Self::EmptyField(field) => {
                write!(f, "El campo {field} no puede estar vacío")
            }
            Self::AbsoluteSourcePath => {
                write!(f, "La ruta de la fuente debe ser relativa")
            }
            Self::InvalidSha256 => {
                write!(f, "El hash SHA-256 no tiene un formato válido")
            }
            Self::DuplicateId { entity, id } => {
                write!(f, "ID duplicado en {entity}: {id}")
            }
            Self::UnknownSource(id) => {
                write!(f, "No existe la fuente con ID {}", id.0)
            }
            Self::UnknownAsset(id) => {
                write!(f, "No existe el activo con ID {}", id.0)
            }
            Self::UnknownEvidence(id) => {
                write!(f, "No existe la evidencia con ID {}", id.0)
            }
            Self::MissingEvidence(entity) => {
                write!(f, "{entity} debe tener al menos una evidencia")
            }
            Self::InvalidConfidence(value) => {
                write!(f, "Confianza inválida: {value}. Debe estar entre 0 y 100")
            }
        }
    }
}

impl std::error::Error for DomainError {}

// Formatos que NEXTRACE podrá incorporar como fuentes.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum SourceFormat {
    Pcap,
    PcapNg,
    FirewallLog,
    RouterConfig,
    SwitchConfig,
    ServerLog,
    Csv,
    Json,
    Text,
    Unknown,
}

// Archivo original incorporado a una investigación.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct SourceFile {
    pub id: SourceId,
    pub file_name: String,
    pub relative_path: PathBuf,
    pub format: SourceFormat,
    pub size_bytes: u64,
    pub sha256: Option<String>,
    pub imported_at_unix_ns: i64,
}

// Tipos de activos o entidades identificables en la red.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum AssetKind {
    IpAddress,
    MacAddress,
    Hostname,
    Network,
    Device,
    Service,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Asset {
    pub id: AssetId,
    pub kind: AssetKind,
    pub value: String,
    pub label: Option<String>,
}

// Localización exacta de un dato dentro de su fuente.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum EvidenceLocation {
    PacketFrame {
        frame_number: u64,
    },
    LogLine {
        line_number: u64,
    },
    ByteRange {
        offset: u64,
        length: u64,
    },
    JsonPath {
        path: String,
    },
}

// Evidencia extraída de un archivo original.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Evidence {
    pub id: EvidenceId,
    pub source_id: SourceId,
    pub location: EvidenceLocation,
    pub excerpt: Option<String>,
}

// Protocolos que el motor puede identificar.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Protocol {
    Tcp,
    Udp,
    Icmp,
    IcmpV6,
    Other(String),
}

// Tipos de eventos que pueden aparecer en una investigación.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum EventKind {
    Packet,
    NetworkFlow,
    FirewallAllow,
    FirewallDeny,
    AuthenticationSuccess,
    AuthenticationFailure,
    ConfigurationChange,
    ServiceState,
    Other(String),
}

// Suceso normalizado y relacionado con sus evidencias.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct NetworkEvent {
    pub id: EventId,
    // Nanosegundos desde Unix epoch, en UTC.
    pub timestamp_unix_ns: Option<i64>,
    pub kind: EventKind,
    pub summary: String,
    pub source_asset: Option<AssetId>,
    pub destination_asset: Option<AssetId>,
    pub source_port: Option<u16>,
    pub destination_port: Option<u16>,
    pub protocol: Option<Protocol>,
    pub evidence_ids: Vec<EvidenceId>,
}

// Diferencia un hecho observado de una interpretación.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum FindingKind {
    Observation,
    Hypothesis,
    Conclusion,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Severity {
    Info,
    Low,
    Medium,
    High,
    Critical,
}

// Resultado del análisis que debe poder justificarse con evidencias.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Finding {
    pub id: FindingId,
    pub kind: FindingKind,
    pub severity: Severity,
    pub title: String,
    pub description: String,
    pub evidence_ids: Vec<EvidenceId>,
    pub confidence_percent: Option<u8>,
}

// Contenedor principal de una investigación.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Investigation {
    pub id: InvestigationId,
    pub name: String,
    pub description: Option<String>,
    pub created_at_unix_ns: i64,

    sources: Vec<SourceFile>,
    assets: Vec<Asset>,
    evidences: Vec<Evidence>,
    events: Vec<NetworkEvent>,
    findings: Vec<Finding>,
}

impl Investigation {
    pub fn new(
        id: InvestigationId,
        name: impl Into<String>,
        description: Option<String>,
        created_at_unix_ns: i64,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError> {
        let name = name.into();

        if name.trim().is_empty() {
            return Err(DomainError::EmptyField("nombre de investigación"));
        }

        Ok(Self {
            id,
            name,
            description,
            created_at_unix_ns,
            sources: Vec::new(),
            assets: Vec::new(),
            evidences: Vec::new(),
            events: Vec::new(),
            findings: Vec::new(),
        })
    }

    pub fn add_source(&mut self, source: SourceFile) -> Result<(), DomainError> {
        if source.file_name.trim().is_empty() {
            return Err(DomainError::EmptyField("nombre del archivo"));
        }

        if source.relative_path.as_os_str().is_empty() {
            return Err(DomainError::EmptyField("ruta de la fuente"));
        }

        if source.relative_path.is_absolute() {
            return Err(DomainError::AbsoluteSourcePath);
        }

        if let Some(hash) = &source.sha256 {
            let valid = hash.len() == 64
                && hash.bytes().all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_hexdigit());

            if !valid {
                return Err(DomainError::InvalidSha256);
            }
        }

        if self.sources.iter().any(|item| item.id == source.id) {
            return Err(DomainError::DuplicateId {
                entity: "fuentes",
                id: source.id.0,
            });
        }

        self.sources.push(source);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn add_asset(&mut self, asset: Asset) -> Result<(), DomainError> {
        if asset.value.trim().is_empty() {
            return Err(DomainError::EmptyField("valor del activo"));
        }

        if self.assets.iter().any(|item| item.id == asset.id) {
            return Err(DomainError::DuplicateId {
                entity: "activos",
                id: asset.id.0,
            });
        }

        self.assets.push(asset);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn add_evidence(&mut self, evidence: Evidence) -> Result<(), DomainError> {
        if !self.sources.iter().any(|item| item.id == evidence.source_id) {
            return Err(DomainError::UnknownSource(evidence.source_id));
        }

        if self.evidences.iter().any(|item| item.id == evidence.id) {
            return Err(DomainError::DuplicateId {
                entity: "evidencias",
                id: evidence.id.0,
            });
        }

        self.evidences.push(evidence);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn add_event(&mut self, event: NetworkEvent) -> Result<(), DomainError> {
        if event.summary.trim().is_empty() {
            return Err(DomainError::EmptyField("resumen del evento"));
        }

        if self.events.iter().any(|item| item.id == event.id) {
            return Err(DomainError::DuplicateId {
                entity: "eventos",
                id: event.id.0,
            });
        }

        for asset_id in [event.source_asset, event.destination_asset]
            .into_iter()
            .flatten()
        {
            if !self.assets.iter().any(|item| item.id == asset_id) {
                return Err(DomainError::UnknownAsset(asset_id));
            }
        }

        if event.evidence_ids.is_empty() {
            return Err(DomainError::MissingEvidence("El evento"));
        }

        for evidence_id in &event.evidence_ids {
            if !self.evidences.iter().any(|item| item.id == *evidence_id) {
                return Err(DomainError::UnknownEvidence(*evidence_id));
            }
        }

        self.events.push(event);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn add_finding(&mut self, finding: Finding) -> Result<(), DomainError> {
        if finding.title.trim().is_empty() {
            return Err(DomainError::EmptyField("título del hallazgo"));
        }

        if finding.description.trim().is_empty() {
            return Err(DomainError::EmptyField("descripción del hallazgo"));
        }

        if self.findings.iter().any(|item| item.id == finding.id) {
            return Err(DomainError::DuplicateId {
                entity: "hallazgos",
                id: finding.id.0,
            });
        }

        if let Some(confidence) = finding.confidence_percent {
            if confidence > 100 {
                return Err(DomainError::InvalidConfidence(confidence));
            }
        }

        if finding.evidence_ids.is_empty() {
            return Err(DomainError::MissingEvidence("El hallazgo"));
        }

        for evidence_id in &finding.evidence_ids {
            if !self.evidences.iter().any(|item| item.id == *evidence_id) {
                return Err(DomainError::UnknownEvidence(*evidence_id));
            }
        }

        self.findings.push(finding);
        Ok(())
    }

    // Acceso de solo lectura a los elementos de la investigación.
    pub fn sources(&self) -> &[SourceFile] {
        &self.sources
    }

    pub fn assets(&self) -> &[Asset] {
        &self.assets
    }

    pub fn evidences(&self) -> &[Evidence] {
        &self.evidences
    }

    pub fn events(&self) -> &[NetworkEvent] {
        &self.events
    }

    pub fn findings(&self) -> &[Finding] {
        &self.findings
    }
}

ARCHIVO: ./src/pcap.rs

use std::io::{self, Read};
use std::net::{IpAddr, Ipv4Addr, Ipv6Addr};

use crate::Protocol;

const PCAP_GLOBAL_HEADER_SIZE: usize = 24;
const PCAP_PACKET_HEADER_SIZE: usize = 16;
const MAX_PACKET_SIZE: u32 = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
const LINKTYPE_ETHERNET: u32 = 1;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
enum ByteOrder {
    Little,
    Big,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum PcapTimestampResolution {
    Microseconds,
    Nanoseconds,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct PcapHeader {
    pub version_major: u16,
    pub version_minor: u16,
    pub snaplen: u32,
    pub link_type: u32,
    pub timestamp_resolution: PcapTimestampResolution,
}

#[derive(Debug)]
pub enum PcapError {
    Io(io::Error),
    InvalidMagic,
    UnsupportedVersion(u16, u16),
    InvalidSnaplen,
    UnsupportedLinkType(u32),
    InvalidTimestampFraction(u32),
    InvalidPacketLengths {
        captured: u32,
        original: u32,
        snaplen: u32,
    },
    PacketTooLarge(u32),
}

impl std::fmt::Display for PcapError {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        match self {
            Self::Io(error) => write!(f, "Error leyendo PCAP: {error}"),
            Self::InvalidMagic => write!(f, "Firma PCAP no reconocida"),
            Self::UnsupportedVersion(major, minor) => {
                write!(f, "Versión PCAP no compatible: {major}.{minor}")
            }
            Self::InvalidSnaplen => write!(f, "El tamaño máximo de captura es inválido"),
            Self::UnsupportedLinkType(link) => {
                write!(f, "Tipo de enlace no compatible: {link}")
            }
            Self::InvalidTimestampFraction(value) => {
                write!(f, "Fracción de tiempo inválida: {value}")
            }
            Self::InvalidPacketLengths {
                captured,
                original,
                snaplen,
            } => write!(
                f,
                "Longitudes de paquete inválidas: capturado={captured}, original={original}, snaplen={snaplen}"
            ),
            Self::PacketTooLarge(size) => {
                write!(f, "Paquete demasiado grande: {size} bytes")
            }
        }
    }
}

impl std::error::Error for PcapError {}

impl From<io::Error> for PcapError {
    fn from(error: io::Error) -> Self {
        Self::Io(error)
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct EthernetInfo {
    pub source_mac: String,
    pub destination_mac: String,
    pub ether_type: u16,
    pub vlan_ids: Vec<u16>,
    pub network: Option<NetworkInfo>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct NetworkInfo {
    pub ip_version: u8,
    pub source_ip: IpAddr,
    pub destination_ip: IpAddr,
    pub protocol: Protocol,
    pub source_port: Option<u16>,
    pub destination_port: Option<u16>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct PcapPacket {
    pub number: u64,
    pub timestamp_unix_ns: i64,
    pub captured_len: u32,
    pub original_len: u32,
    pub ethernet: Option<EthernetInfo>,
}

pub struct PcapReader<R: Read> {
    reader: R,
    header: PcapHeader,
    byte_order: ByteOrder,
    packet_number: u64,
}

impl<R: Read> PcapReader<R> {
    pub fn new(mut reader: R) -> Result<Self, PcapError> {
        let mut magic = [0u8; 4];
        reader.read_exact(&mut magic)?;

        let (byte_order, resolution) = match magic {
            [0xd4, 0xc3, 0xb2, 0xa1] => (
                ByteOrder::Little,
                PcapTimestampResolution::Microseconds,
            ),
            [0xa1, 0xb2, 0xc3, 0xd4] => (
                ByteOrder::Big,
                PcapTimestampResolution::Microseconds,
            ),
            [0x4d, 0x3c, 0xb2, 0xa1] => (
                ByteOrder::Little,
                PcapTimestampResolution::Nanoseconds,
            ),
            [0xa1, 0xb2, 0x3c, 0x4d] => (
                ByteOrder::Big,
                PcapTimestampResolution::Nanoseconds,
            ),
            _ => return Err(PcapError::InvalidMagic),
        };

        let mut rest = [0u8; PCAP_GLOBAL_HEADER_SIZE - 4];
        reader.read_exact(&mut rest)?;

        let major = read_u16(&rest[0..2], byte_order);
        let minor = read_u16(&rest[2..4], byte_order);
        let snaplen = read_u32(&rest[12..16], byte_order);
        let link_type = read_u32(&rest[16..20], byte_order);

        if major != 2 || minor != 4 {
            return Err(PcapError::UnsupportedVersion(major, minor));
        }

        if snaplen == 0 {
            return Err(PcapError::InvalidSnaplen);
        }

        if link_type != LINKTYPE_ETHERNET {
            return Err(PcapError::UnsupportedLinkType(link_type));
        }

        Ok(Self {
            reader,
            header: PcapHeader {
                version_major: major,
                version_minor: minor,
                snaplen,
                link_type,
                timestamp_resolution: resolution,
            },
            byte_order,
            packet_number: 0,
        })
    }

    pub fn header(&self) -> &PcapHeader {
        &self.header
    }

    /// Lee el siguiente paquete. Devuelve None al llegar al final.
    pub fn next_packet(&mut self) -> Result<Option<PcapPacket>, PcapError> {
        let mut packet_header = [0u8; PCAP_PACKET_HEADER_SIZE];

        // Leemos el primer byte para distinguir el final normal
        // del archivo de un registro incompleto.
        let first_byte = loop {
            match self.reader.read(&mut packet_header[0..1]) {
                Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::Interrupted => continue,
                result => break result?,
            }
        };

        if first_byte == 0 {
            return Ok(None);
        }

        self.reader.read_exact(&mut packet_header[1..])?;

        let seconds = read_u32(&packet_header[0..4], self.byte_order);
        let fraction = read_u32(&packet_header[4..8], self.byte_order);
        let captured_len = read_u32(&packet_header[8..12], self.byte_order);
        let original_len = read_u32(&packet_header[12..16], self.byte_order);

        let fraction_limit = match self.header.timestamp_resolution {
            PcapTimestampResolution::Microseconds => 1_000_000,
            PcapTimestampResolution::Nanoseconds => 1_000_000_000,
        };

        if fraction >= fraction_limit {
            return Err(PcapError::InvalidTimestampFraction(fraction));
        }

        if captured_len > self.header.snaplen
            || original_len < captured_len
        {
            return Err(PcapError::InvalidPacketLengths {
                captured: captured_len,
                original: original_len,
                snaplen: self.header.snaplen,
            });
        }

        if captured_len > MAX_PACKET_SIZE {
            return Err(PcapError::PacketTooLarge(captured_len));
        }

        let fraction_ns = match self.header.timestamp_resolution {
            PcapTimestampResolution::Microseconds => fraction as i64 * 1_000,
            PcapTimestampResolution::Nanoseconds => fraction as i64,
        };

        let timestamp_unix_ns =
            seconds as i64 * 1_000_000_000 + fraction_ns;

        let mut frame = vec![0u8; captured_len as usize];
        self.reader.read_exact(&mut frame)?;

        self.packet_number += 1;

        Ok(Some(PcapPacket {
            number: self.packet_number,
            timestamp_unix_ns,
            captured_len,
            original_len,
            ethernet: parse_ethernet(&frame),
        }))
    }
}

fn read_u16(bytes: &[u8], order: ByteOrder) -> u16 {
    let pair = [bytes[0], bytes[1]];

    match order {
        ByteOrder::Little => u16::from_le_bytes(pair),
        ByteOrder::Big => u16::from_be_bytes(pair),
    }
}

fn read_u32(bytes: &[u8], order: ByteOrder) -> u32 {
    let array = [bytes[0], bytes[1], bytes[2], bytes[3]];

    match order {
        ByteOrder::Little => u32::from_le_bytes(array),
        ByteOrder::Big => u32::from_be_bytes(array),
    }
}

fn format_mac(bytes: &[u8]) -> String {
    bytes
        .iter()
        .map(|byte| format!("{byte:02x}"))
        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
        .join(":")
}

fn parse_ethernet(frame: &[u8]) -> Option<EthernetInfo> {
    if frame.len() < 14 {
        return None;
    }

    let destination_mac = format_mac(&frame[0..6]);
    let source_mac = format_mac(&frame[6..12]);

    let mut ether_type = u16::from_be_bytes([frame[12], frame[13]]);
    let mut offset = 14;
    let mut vlan_ids = Vec::new();

    // Permite hasta cuatro etiquetas VLAN apiladas.
    for _ in 0..4 {
        if !matches!(ether_type, 0x8100 | 0x88a8 | 0x9100) {
            break;
        }

        if frame.len() < offset + 4 {
            break;
        }

        let tag_control = u16::from_be_bytes([
            frame[offset],
            frame[offset + 1],
        ]);

        vlan_ids.push(tag_control & 0x0fff);

        ether_type = u16::from_be_bytes([
            frame[offset + 2],
            frame[offset + 3],
        ]);

        offset += 4;
    }

    let network = match ether_type {
        0x0800 => parse_ipv4(frame, offset),
        0x86dd => parse_ipv6(frame, offset),
        _ => None,
    };

    Some(EthernetInfo {
        source_mac,
        destination_mac,
        ether_type,
        vlan_ids,
        network,
    })
}

fn parse_ipv4(frame: &[u8], offset: usize) -> Option<NetworkInfo> {
    if frame.len() < offset + 20 {
        return None;
    }

    let first = frame[offset];

    if first >> 4 != 4 {
        return None;
    }

    let header_length = ((first & 0x0f) as usize) * 4;

    if header_length < 20 || frame.len() < offset + header_length {
        return None;
    }

    let total_length = u16::from_be_bytes([
        frame[offset + 2],
        frame[offset + 3],
    ]) as usize;

    if total_length < header_length {
        return None;
    }

    let packet_end = offset
        .saturating_add(total_length)
        .min(frame.len());

    let protocol_number = frame[offset + 9];

    let fragment_field = u16::from_be_bytes([
        frame[offset + 6],
        frame[offset + 7],
    ]);

    let fragment_offset = fragment_field & 0x1fff;

    let source_ip = IpAddr::V4(Ipv4Addr::new(
        frame[offset + 12],
        frame[offset + 13],
        frame[offset + 14],
        frame[offset + 15],
    ));

    let destination_ip = IpAddr::V4(Ipv4Addr::new(
        frame[offset + 16],
        frame[offset + 17],
        frame[offset + 18],
        frame[offset + 19],
    ));

    let protocol = match protocol_number {
        1 => Protocol::Icmp,
        6 => Protocol::Tcp,
        17 => Protocol::Udp,
        58 => Protocol::IcmpV6,
        value => Protocol::Other(format!("IPv4 protocol {value}")),
    };

    let (source_port, destination_port) = if fragment_offset == 0 {
        parse_ports(frame, offset + header_length, packet_end, protocol_number)
    } else {
        (None, None)
    };

    Some(NetworkInfo {
        ip_version: 4,
        source_ip,
        destination_ip,
        protocol,
        source_port,
        destination_port,
    })
}

fn parse_ipv6(frame: &[u8], offset: usize) -> Option<NetworkInfo> {
    if frame.len() < offset + 40 || frame[offset] >> 4 != 6 {
        return None;
    }

    let payload_length = u16::from_be_bytes([
        frame[offset + 4],
        frame[offset + 5],
    ]) as usize;

    let packet_end = offset
        .saturating_add(40)
        .saturating_add(payload_length)
        .min(frame.len());

    let next_header = frame[offset + 6];

    let mut source_bytes = [0u8; 16];
    source_bytes.copy_from_slice(&frame[offset + 8..offset + 24]);

    let mut destination_bytes = [0u8; 16];
    destination_bytes.copy_from_slice(&frame[offset + 24..offset + 40]);

    let source_ip = IpAddr::V6(Ipv6Addr::from(source_bytes));
    let destination_ip = IpAddr::V6(Ipv6Addr::from(destination_bytes));

    let protocol = match next_header {
        6 => Protocol::Tcp,
        17 => Protocol::Udp,
        58 => Protocol::IcmpV6,
        value => Protocol::Other(format!("IPv6 next header {value}")),
    };

    // En esta versión solo se interpretan cabeceras TCP/UDP
    // cuando aparecen directamente después de la cabecera IPv6.
    let (source_port, destination_port) =
        parse_ports(frame, offset + 40, packet_end, next_header);

    Some(NetworkInfo {
        ip_version: 6,
        source_ip,
        destination_ip,
        protocol,
        source_port,
        destination_port,
    })
}

fn parse_ports(
    frame: &[u8],
    offset: usize,
    packet_end: usize,
    protocol_number: u8,
) -> (Option<u16>, Option<u16>) {
    if !matches!(protocol_number, 6 | 17) {
        return (None, None);
    }

    if packet_end < offset + 4 {
        return (None, None);
    }

    let source = u16::from_be_bytes([
        frame[offset],
        frame[offset + 1],
    ]);

    let destination = u16::from_be_bytes([
        frame[offset + 2],
        frame[offset + 3],
    ]);

    (Some(source), Some(destination))
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use std::io::Cursor;

    fn sample_frame() -> Vec<u8> {
        let mut frame = Vec::new();

        // Ethernet: destino y origen.
        frame.extend_from_slice(&[0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]);
        frame.extend_from_slice(&[6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11]);

        // EtherType: IPv4.
        frame.extend_from_slice(&[0x08, 0x00]);

        // IPv4: 192.168.1.10 -> 1.1.1.1, TCP.
        frame.extend_from_slice(&[
            0x45, 0x00, 0x00, 0x28,
            0x00, 0x01, 0x40, 0x00,
            64, 6, 0, 0,
            192, 168, 1, 10,
            1, 1, 1, 1,
        ]);

        // TCP: puerto 50000 -> 443.
        frame.extend_from_slice(&[
            0xc3, 0x50, 0x01, 0xbb,
            0, 0, 0, 1,
            0, 0, 0, 0,
            0x50, 0x02, 0x20, 0,
            0, 0, 0, 0,
        ]);

        frame
    }

    fn sample_pcap() -> Vec<u8> {
        let frame = sample_frame();
        let mut bytes = Vec::new();

        // Cabecera global PCAP little-endian, microsegundos.
        bytes.extend_from_slice(&[0xd4, 0xc3, 0xb2, 0xa1]);
        bytes.extend_from_slice(&2u16.to_le_bytes());
        bytes.extend_from_slice(&4u16.to_le_bytes());
        bytes.extend_from_slice(&0u32.to_le_bytes());
        bytes.extend_from_slice(&0u32.to_le_bytes());
        bytes.extend_from_slice(&65535u32.to_le_bytes());
        bytes.extend_from_slice(&1u32.to_le_bytes());

        // Cabecera del paquete: 1 segundo y 500000 microsegundos.
        bytes.extend_from_slice(&1u32.to_le_bytes());
        bytes.extend_from_slice(&500_000u32.to_le_bytes());
        bytes.extend_from_slice(&(frame.len() as u32).to_le_bytes());
        bytes.extend_from_slice(&(frame.len() as u32).to_le_bytes());

        bytes.extend_from_slice(&frame);
        bytes
    }

    #[test]
    fn reads_pcap_header_and_packet() {
        let data = sample_pcap();
        let mut reader = PcapReader::new(Cursor::new(data)).unwrap();

        assert_eq!(reader.header().version_major, 2);
        assert_eq!(reader.header().version_minor, 4);
        assert_eq!(reader.header().link_type, LINKTYPE_ETHERNET);

        let packet = reader.next_packet().unwrap().unwrap();

        assert_eq!(packet.number, 1);
        assert_eq!(packet.timestamp_unix_ns, 1_500_000_000);
        assert_eq!(packet.captured_len, 54);
        assert_eq!(packet.original_len, 54);

        assert!(reader.next_packet().unwrap().is_none());
    }

    #[test]
    fn extracts_ethernet_ipv4_and_tcp_information() {
        let mut reader = PcapReader::new(Cursor::new(sample_pcap())).unwrap();
        let packet = reader.next_packet().unwrap().unwrap();

        let ethernet = packet.ethernet.unwrap();

        assert_eq!(ethernet.source_mac, "06:07:08:09:0a:0b");
        assert_eq!(ethernet.destination_mac, "00:01:02:03:04:05");
        assert_eq!(ethernet.ether_type, 0x0800);

        let network = ethernet.network.unwrap();

        assert_eq!(network.ip_version, 4);
        assert_eq!(
            network.source_ip,
            IpAddr::V4(Ipv4Addr::new(192, 168, 1, 10))
        );
        assert_eq!(
            network.destination_ip,
            IpAddr::V4(Ipv4Addr::new(1, 1, 1, 1))
        );

        assert_eq!(network.protocol, Protocol::Tcp);
        assert_eq!(network.source_port, Some(50000));
        assert_eq!(network.destination_port, Some(443));
    }

    #[test]
    fn rejects_unsupported_link_type() {
        let mut data = sample_pcap();

        // Campo link_type de la cabecera global.
        data[20..24].copy_from_slice(&113u32.to_le_bytes());

        let result = PcapReader::new(Cursor::new(data));

        assert!(matches!(
            result,
            Err(PcapError::UnsupportedLinkType(113))
        ));
    }

    #[test]
    fn rejects_invalid_timestamp_fraction() {
        let mut data = sample_pcap();

        // Fracción de segundo igual a 1.000.000:
        // no es válida en un archivo con resolución de microsegundos.
        data[28..32].copy_from_slice(&1_000_000u32.to_le_bytes());

        let mut reader = PcapReader::new(Cursor::new(data)).unwrap();

        assert!(matches!(
            reader.next_packet(),
            Err(PcapError::InvalidTimestampFraction(1_000_000))
        ));
    }
}

ARCHIVO: ./src/source_store.rs

use std::fs::{self, File, OpenOptions};
use std::io::{self, copy};
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::process::Command;

use crate::{DomainError, Investigation, SourceFile, SourceFormat, SourceId};

#[derive(Debug)]
pub enum SourceImportError {
    Io(io::Error),
    Domain(DomainError),
    NotRegularFile(PathBuf),
    HashToolUnavailable,
    HashFailed(String),
    InvalidHashOutput,
}

impl std::fmt::Display for SourceImportError {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        match self {
            Self::Io(error) => write!(f, "Error de archivos: {error}"),
            Self::Domain(error) => write!(f, "Error de investigación: {error}"),
            Self::NotRegularFile(path) => {
                write!(f, "No es un archivo normal: {}", path.display())
            }
            Self::HashToolUnavailable => {
                write!(f, "No se encontró sha256sum en el sistema")
            }
            Self::HashFailed(message) => {
                write!(f, "No se pudo calcular SHA-256: {message}")
            }
            Self::InvalidHashOutput => {
                write!(f, "sha256sum devolvió un resultado no válido")
            }
        }
    }
}

impl std::error::Error for SourceImportError {}

impl From<io::Error> for SourceImportError {
    fn from(error: io::Error) -> Self {
        Self::Io(error)
    }
}

impl From<DomainError> for SourceImportError {
    fn from(error: DomainError) -> Self {
        Self::Domain(error)
    }
}

/// Importa una copia del archivo a la investigación.
/// El archivo original permanece intacto.
pub fn import_source(
    investigation: &mut Investigation,
    source_id: SourceId,
    original_path: &Path,
    investigation_dir: &Path,
    imported_at_unix_ns: i64,
) -> Result<SourceFile, SourceImportError> {
    // No permitir IDs repetidos dentro de la investigación.
    if investigation.sources().iter().any(|source| source.id == source_id) {
        return Err(SourceImportError::Domain(DomainError::DuplicateId {
            entity: "fuentes",
            id: source_id.0,
        }));
    }

    let original_name = original_path
        .file_name()
        .and_then(|name| name.to_str())
        .filter(|name| !name.trim().is_empty())
        .ok_or_else(|| {
            SourceImportError::Io(io::Error::new(
                io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput,
                "La ruta no contiene un nombre de archivo válido",
            ))
        })?;

    let mut input = File::open(original_path)?;
    let metadata = input.metadata()?;

    if !metadata.is_file() {
        return Err(SourceImportError::NotRegularFile(
            original_path.to_path_buf(),
        ));
    }

    // Todas las fuentes originales se guardan en esta subcarpeta.
    let sources_dir = investigation_dir.join("sources");
    fs::create_dir_all(&sources_dir)?;

    // El ID diferencia archivos con el mismo nombre.
    let stored_name = format!("{}_{}", source_id.0, original_name);
    let destination = sources_dir.join(&stored_name);

    // create_new impide sobrescribir una fuente que ya exista.
    let mut output = OpenOptions::new()
        .write(true)
        .create_new(true)
        .open(&destination)?;

    // Copia por bloques, sin cargar el archivo completo en RAM.
    if let Err(error) = copy(&mut input, &mut output) {
        drop(output);
        let _ = fs::remove_file(&destination);
        return Err(SourceImportError::Io(error));
    }

    if let Err(error) = output.sync_all() {
        drop(output);
        let _ = fs::remove_file(&destination);
        return Err(SourceImportError::Io(error));
    }

    drop(output);

    // Calculamos el hash de la copia que realmente conservaremos.
    let sha256 = match calculate_sha256(&destination) {
        Ok(hash) => hash,
        Err(error) => {
            let _ = fs::remove_file(&destination);
            return Err(error);
        }
    };

    let size_bytes = match fs::metadata(&destination) {
        Ok(metadata) => metadata.len(),
        Err(error) => {
            let _ = fs::remove_file(&destination);
            return Err(SourceImportError::Io(error));
        }
    };

    let source = SourceFile {
        id: source_id,
        file_name: original_name.to_string(),
        relative_path: PathBuf::from("sources").join(&stored_name),
        format: detect_format(original_path),
        size_bytes,
        sha256: Some(sha256),
        imported_at_unix_ns,
    };

    // Registrar la fuente en la investigación.
    if let Err(error) = investigation.add_source(source.clone()) {
        let _ = fs::remove_file(&destination);
        return Err(SourceImportError::Domain(error));
    }

    Ok(source)
}

/// Utiliza la herramienta sha256sum del sistema.
/// Lee el archivo de forma progresiva, sin cargarlo entero en memoria.
fn calculate_sha256(path: &Path) -> Result<String, SourceImportError> {
    let output = Command::new("sha256sum")
        .arg("--")
        .arg(path)
        .output()
        .map_err(|error| {
            if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound {
                SourceImportError::HashToolUnavailable
            } else {
                SourceImportError::Io(error)
            }
        })?;

    if !output.status.success() {
        return Err(SourceImportError::HashFailed(
            String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr)
                .trim()
                .to_string(),
        ));
    }

    let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout);

    let hash = stdout
        .split_whitespace()
        .next()
        .ok_or(SourceImportError::InvalidHashOutput)?;

    if hash.len() != 64 || !hash.bytes().all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_hexdigit()) {
        return Err(SourceImportError::InvalidHashOutput);
    }

    Ok(hash.to_ascii_lowercase())
}

/// Clasificación preliminar basada en la extensión.
/// Más adelante el analizador verificará el contenido real del archivo.
fn detect_format(path: &Path) -> SourceFormat {
    match path.extension().and_then(|extension| extension.to_str()) {
        Some(ext) if ext.eq_ignore_ascii_case("pcap") => SourceFormat::Pcap,
        Some(ext) if ext.eq_ignore_ascii_case("pcapng") => SourceFormat::PcapNg,
        Some(ext) if ext.eq_ignore_ascii_case("csv") => SourceFormat::Csv,
        Some(ext) if ext.eq_ignore_ascii_case("json") => SourceFormat::Json,
        Some(ext) if ext.eq_ignore_ascii_case("txt") => SourceFormat::Text,
        _ => SourceFormat::Unknown,
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::InvestigationId;
    use std::time::{SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH};

    fn temporary_directory(label: &str) -> PathBuf {
        let nonce = SystemTime::now()
            .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
            .unwrap()
            .as_nanos();

        let path = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
            "nextrace-{label}-{}-{nonce}",
            std::process::id()
        ));

        fs::create_dir_all(&path).unwrap();
        path
    }

    #[test]
    fn imports_copy_and_hash_without_removing_original() {
        let temp = temporary_directory("import");
        let original = temp.join("capture.pcap");
        let investigation_dir = temp.join("investigation");

        let contents = b"NEXTRACE test capture\n";
        fs::write(&original, contents).unwrap();

        let mut investigation = Investigation::new(
            InvestigationId(1),
            "Test",
            None,
            0,
        )
        .unwrap();

        let source = import_source(
            &mut investigation,
            SourceId(1),
            &original,
            &investigation_dir,
            10,
        )
        .unwrap();

        let stored = investigation_dir.join(&source.relative_path);

        // El original permanece y la copia contiene los mismos bytes.
        assert!(original.exists());
        assert_eq!(fs::read(&stored).unwrap(), contents);

        assert_eq!(source.size_bytes, contents.len() as u64);
        assert_eq!(source.format, SourceFormat::Pcap);

        // SHA-256 conocido del contenido de prueba.
        assert_eq!(
            source.sha256.as_deref(),
            Some("02e047997b2836cc0d4ceed4a84c3cef83744d9646877648c0e22693c83b7e23")
        );

        assert_eq!(investigation.sources().len(), 1);

        fs::remove_dir_all(temp).unwrap();
    }

    #[test]
    fn refuses_to_overwrite_an_existing_stored_file() {
        let temp = temporary_directory("collision");
        let original = temp.join("capture.txt");
        let investigation_dir = temp.join("investigation");

        fs::write(&original, b"test").unwrap();

        let sources_dir = investigation_dir.join("sources");
        fs::create_dir_all(&sources_dir).unwrap();

        let existing = sources_dir.join("7_capture.txt");
        fs::write(&existing, b"existing").unwrap();

        let mut investigation = Investigation::new(
            InvestigationId(1),
            "Test",
            None,
            0,
        )
        .unwrap();

        let result = import_source(
            &mut investigation,
            SourceId(7),
            &original,
            &investigation_dir,
            10,
        );

        assert!(result.is_err());

        // El archivo previo no debe haber sido modificado.
        assert_eq!(fs::read(&existing).unwrap(), b"existing");
        assert!(investigation.sources().is_empty());

        fs::remove_dir_all(temp).unwrap();
    }
}
